messages:
marie.sales: Heads-up — DataShield just uploaded a completed SIG/CAIQ and a few freeform Qs. They want answers before the POC kickoff next Thursday. Can security pick this up? Link: https://drive.google.com/datashield/SIG-CAIQ-2026.pdf :pushpin:

ben.support: Thanks — do we have NDA attached? Also any immediate blockers for the POC?

marie.sales: NDA is signed and in Drive (same folder). POC will run on Dedicated capacity in eu-west-1. Main asks from their side: data residency, encryption at rest/transport, key mgmt, SOC2 and incident response SLA wording.

alex.security: Assigning to me. I can triage the SIG today. Quick q: do they require HSM/KMS separation or just KMS integration?

marie.sales: They flagged HSM as preferred but said "can accept KMS" for the POC scope. Will escalate if they push for HSM in contract.

alex.security: OK. Initial plan: 1) baseline SIG answers + attach evidence (SOC2 summary, disk encryption config, network diagrams) 2) identify any high-risk items that need engineering support 3) target 48–72h turnaround for the document draft. If anything scores as high-risk we’ll flag to eng.

ben.support: Noted. I can pull the SOC2 artifact and network diagram and drop in the folder. Do you want sample config (terraform snippets) for Dedicated?

alex.security: Yes please — any concrete config for customer-facing Dedicated (VPC peering, subnets, kms keys) helps. Put it under /evidence/infra.

devon.custsuccess: From customer side: Sanjay (security lead) wants explicit answer on log retention and where logs are stored. They also asked if we can provide a contact for incident escalation during the POC window.

alex.security: Good call. For log retention we have standard retention 90 days in hosted logs, dedicated customers can configure via Redwood Console — will provide options and SLOs. For escalation I'll share the on-call rotation contact and SOC contact email.

marie.sales: Sanjay's email: sanjay@datashield.io. POC kickoff is 2026-03-30. Need doc in their hands by 2026-03-26 EOD.

alex.security: Timeline check: today = intake + evidence collection. Tomorrow morning I'll post the first draft. If eng changes are needed, we'll tag them and estimate time.

ben.support: Dropping artifacts now: https://drive.google.com/datashield/evidence — added SOC2-summary.pdf, network-diagram.png, tf-dedicated-example.tf

sec-bot: New security intake created: SEC-INTAKE-2026-328 assigned to alex.security — please update ticket with progress and set priority.

alex.security: Thanks bot. Setting priority = P2 for now (POC gating).

marie.sales: Awesome — can you call out any licensing/pricing implications if they request HSM-backed keys? I need to include that in the commercial thread.

alex.security: Yep — short note: HSM adds ops overhead and usually requires Dedicated+Private networking + HSM integration fee. I'll add a pricing note and ping product for exact dollars if it looks required.

devon.custsuccess: If you want, I can run a quick sync with Sanjay after the draft to go over answers.

alex.security: Please do. Once draft is ready I'll link it here and assign the review.

marie.sales: Thanks team — huge help. pinging @devon.custsuccess for customer follow-up. :pray:

ben.support: Reminder set for 2026-03-25 to check on final sign-off.

alex.security: Draft uploaded: https://drive.google.com/datashield/SIG-CAIQ-2026-draft.docx — major items: encryption (OK, KMS), evidence attached, HSM = escalation to eng/product, log retention options (90d default / config for Dedicated), incident escalation contact included.

marie.sales: Perfect. I'll loop in pricing and legal if HSM gets requested.

devon.custsuccess: I'll schedule a 30m sync with Sanjay for 2026-03-26 09:00 CET to review.

alex.security: Thanks all — closing intake here. Will update SEC-INTAKE-2026-328 with final doc and risk summary after the sync.

marie.sales: Closing on our side. :white_check_mark:
